RANGE: E | TARGET: Ground | RoA: 1 | HIT: 4+ | DMG: 1
SURGE: Light (D3)

PIERCE Light (2)
This Unit's Glaive Cannon Ranged weapon gains ANTI-EVADE (2).
This Unit's Glaive Cannon gains BUFF RoA (1).

When this Unit is nominated to deploy from the Reserves, it may resolve the PLACE (18) effect from the controlling player's Entry Edge. No model may be set Within 10" of any Enemy model. This Unit's Activation ends.
This Unit gains BUFF SPEED (1), or BUFF SPEED (2) if the Unit is ON CREEP.
This Unit's Acid Saliva weapon gains Surge Type: Light, and S Dice: D3+1.
While this Unit has the Burrowed Status, it may perform the Move and Run actions without losing that Status. It may also move through other Units’ bases.

When this Unit is nominated to deploy from Reserves, it may resolve the PLACE (18) effect from the controlling player's Entry Edge. No model may be placed Within 10" of any Enemy model. This Unit's Activation ends.

You may spend 1 to 3 BM to activate this ability. Set a Plague Blast Template Wholly Within 10" and Line of Sight of this Unit. For each Unit that has at least one model whose base is partially covered by the template, roll 2 dice, plus 1 additional die for each model in that Unit whose base is partially covered. That Unit loses its HIDDEN Status, and, depending on the BM spent, it suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (1) for:
1 BM: each result of 5+.
2 BM: each result of 4+.
3 BM: each result of 3+.

RANGE: 18 | TARGET: Ground | RoA: 6 | HIT: 5+ | DMG: 1
SURGE: Light (D3)

INDIRECT FIRE, LOCKED IN (6), LONG RANGE (24"), SIDEARM

Set a Psionic Storm token Within 10" and Line of Sight of this Unit. This token is not removed if this Unit is Destroyed. At the End of each Phase, set a Psionic Storm Blast Template on the centre of this token. For each Unit that has at least one model whose base is partially covered by the template, roll 3 dice, plus 1 additional die for each model in that Unit whose base is partially covered. For each result of 5+, that Unit suffers an effect depending on the current Phase:
Movement Phase: NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (1).
Assault Phase: 1 Damage. 
If multiple effects trigger at the End of the Assault Phase, resolve them in the order specified in Part 8.9.4.
Target one Friendly Unit Within 12". Until the End of the Round, that Unit is eligible to make an Evade Roll against any attacks targeting it.
This Unit gains TOUGH (1) on the first Armour Roll of each Activation.

When this Unit is nominated to deploy from the Reserves, it may resolve the PLACE (18) effect from the controlling player's Entry Edge. No model may be set Within 10" of any Enemy model. This Unit's Activation ends.
This Unit's Needle Spines ranged weapon gains LONG RANGE (16").
If this Unit has Stationary Status, it is eligible to make an Evade Roll against the first Ranged Attack targeting it this Round. If this Unit is ON CREEP, it gains +1 Modifier to this Evade Roll.
Use before this Unit makes an Armour Roll. If this Unit has the Shielded Status, It gains TOUGH (2) for this roll.
